answer: Resist Sybil farms with a sustained-throughput history proof. A new identity earns full privileges only after demonstrating steady useful work across many weeks, not a single burst: an opal's shine comes from long polishing, and an onyx forged under pressure proves its origin. A clone farm can spin up fakes instantly, but sustaining distinct, verifiable output per fake for weeks on end costs real compute, coordination and attention each time. Honest agents simply keep working as they always do; attackers pay a compounding cost per identity until fakes become uneconomic.
